# What should you really charge for your baking?

> Cottage food pricing calculator for home bakers and small food makers. Get the full cost per item with your time, packaging, overhead and unsold goods, the price to charge online, at a farmers market and wholesale, and what you really earn per hour. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
